Locked Account (Failed Vetting).notes_template:
QUERY: The caller is calling regarding their user profile being locked due to failed vetting on the portal.
STATUS: Profile verified on DCE. Account status confirmed inactive due to vetting failure.
ADVICE: Advised caller to submit clear copy of ID and proof of address to online support for verification and profile unlocking.

Locked Account (Incorrect Password).notes_template:
QUERY: Caller unable to access portal due to multiple incorrect password attempts.
STATUS: System shows account temporarily locked.
ADVICE: Initiated password reset link to caller's registered email address. Advised to wait 15 minutes before attempting login.

Password Reset.notes_template:
QUERY: Caller requesting password reset assistance for UIF online portal.
STATUS: Registered credentials and email confirmed with caller.
ADVICE: Reset password procedure completed. Instructed caller to log in and update temporary credentials.
